verdicts.evidence: lines 425, 469-470, 539-552, 594-605, 658-667: every button and radio has a handler that does what its label names. Narrow edge: stopping an import of 5 or fewer rows at the very end leaves 'Import the remaining 0 contacts', which returns early at 565.
lines 457-461, 474-537, 555-560, 612-640: all rows, counts and progress come from the pasted text and the api results; missing values show '(blank)' (504); no sample or placeholder text anywhere.

lines 473-537: the review step lists the rows with their problems and the good/bad counts beside the Import button; 570 and 558 carry the total into the import step; 612-640 the result restates imported, skipped and remaining counts.

lines 283-289: textarea saved to sessionStorage and restored on reload; 410 file text saved too; 454 server error keeps the text; 670-680 Back returns to the input with text intact and Forward restores the review if unchanged; 681 guards reload during import.

lines 378-379: on each step focus goes to the heading or textarea, never the Import button; Enter in the textarea adds a line and the only submit is the read-only check (469); default filter (463) only changes what is shown.
lines 128-206, 368-380: paste, check, import and outcome all happen in one page with no dialog or other screen; the single extra step is the review the brief asks for before importing.

lines 118-206: input (paste or file), review table with problems filter, import progress with stop, and outcome. Each maps to the brief; the step list and the undo for a file overwriting pasted text support those tasks. No stat cards or extras.

lines 141-148: only 'Check contacts' is primary on step 1; 159-160 and 489-491: Import is primary and Back plain, Back becomes primary only when Import is hidden; 192 one plain button; 203-204 one primary, one plain.

No delete action exists. The only overwrite is choosing a file over pasted text (409-414): a plain file control, not primary, not on Enter, with an Undo button (141, 425). Stop import (192) is a plain secondary button.
lines 442 and 602: aria-disabled is set only while the button's own request runs (labels 'Checking N rows...', 'Stopping...'); 489 hides Import when no row is good and 480-482 says why in text.
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.
lines 118-206 and all strings in 322-346, 354-362, 401-429, 454, 477-486, 612-640: text is about contacts, rows and the import only; no mention of implementation, mock data or the request.

line 133 hint sits under the field label; 157 column-order note shows only for headerless input, on the review before Import; 194 'If you stop, contacts already imported stay in the CRM' sits by Stop import. Each informs a decision at that point.
No sentence narrates the page. Remaining guidance is short and at its control: 133 column hint under the label; 482 and 486 state the choice next to the Import and Back buttons; 194 beside Stop.

line 133 hint adds columns and required fields, not a restatement of the label 132; 484-486 title gives ready rows, subtitle gives skipped rows; count line 533-535 says how much of the list is displayed, though it repeats the number in the filter label 493.

All visible strings (118-206, 322-346, 401-429, 454, 477-486, 612-640) are factual; no greetings, slogans, superlatives, congratulations or exclamation marks. Success heading is plain 'N contacts imported' (615).

Labels: 'Check contacts' 148, 'Try again' 145, 'Import N contacts' 490, 'Back to edit contacts' 160, 'Show N more rows' 537, 'Stop import' 192, 'Import more contacts' 624, 'Edit the N skipped rows' 622, 'Import the remaining N contacts' 638. No OK/Submit/Done.

lines 354-362: server codes REQUIRED, EMAIL_FORMAT, PHONE_FORMAT, DUPLICATE_IN_CRM are mapped to sentences such as 'Email is missing' and 'Already in the CRM with this email'; column heads 171-176 are plain words; no ids or enum values shown.

lines 322, 324, 335, 346: input errors name the problem and the fix; 454 check failure names cause and state with Try again (145); 401 and 421 file errors give a next step; 629-640 import failures give counts and a resume button. e.message is never shown.

line 634: result heading 'The import failed. No contacts were imported' uses 'failed', which the rule excludes. Reached when the server rejects before any row is saved. Other error text is neutral and has no exclamation marks or capitals.

The review table cannot render with zero rows: empty input is refused at 322 ('There are no contacts yet. Paste CSV text or choose a file.') and header-only at 346; zero problem rows switches to all rows (463) with 'All N rows are ready to import' (477).

Distinct messages and actions: nothing entered 322 (paste or choose a file), header only 346 (add a row), check failed 454 with Try again 145, all rows bad 480-482 with Back as primary. Filter is hidden unless both groups exist (492) so it cannot match nothing.

lines 446-455: validate retried, then a failure block above the button with Try again; textarea untouched. 583-592 and 626-640: failed import states saved and remaining counts and offers 'Import the remaining N' with the queue kept (586).

lines 442-444: check button turns to 'Checking N rows...' synchronously (worst case about 4.5 s over 3 attempts); import shows a progress element and 'X of Y contacts imported' (555-560) plus 'Stop import' wired to the abort signal (598-605).

lines 441-468: the review view and its counts are rendered only after validateImport resolves; while waiting the user stays on step 1 with a busy button. No empty-state text or zero counts appear during the wait.

line 87 overflow-wrap:anywhere on cells; 504 missing values show '(blank)'; 267 and 510-537 show 200 rows at a time with 'Show N more rows'; 257 numbers formatted; 343 short rows default to empty strings so no undefined; S.total is never 0 at 561.
lines 283-289: the pasted text is kept in sessionStorage on every edit and restored on return; 681-683 beforeunload prompts while an import is running; 672 blocks browser Back during import.

line 133: 'Columns: name, email, phone, company. Name and email are required.' is visible under the label before input and linked by aria-describedby (134). The 5 MB file cap (399-401) is only stated on error, but is far above the stated use.

line 133 says in words 'Name and email are required'; 138 labels the file input 'Or choose a CSV file', marking it as the alternative route. Form is novalidate with script checks (130, 322); no required attribute is used on any field.

lines 286-289: the input listener only saves the draft and hides undo, it never validates; validation runs on submit only (433-438, 469) and the field error is cleared on the next successful parse (438).

line 135: error paragraph directly under the textarea, with 'Problem: ' prefix (62) and thicker border (50); row problems appear in the Problem cell of the same row as text (521-525) with the offending cell marked (502).
lines 437 and 453-455: on a client or server rejection the textarea value is never changed; csv.readOnly is reset (449) and the text stays; it is only cleared after a completed import (625).

line 437: csv.focus() on a rejected submit; 386 sets aria-invalid='true'; 134 aria-describedby references csv-error, which is role=alert (135). Server failure uses a role=alert message with a retry button (143-146).

line 148: submit button has no disabled state at rest; 436-437 submitting empty or malformed text shows what is missing and focuses the field; 442-450 aria-disabled only while the check request is in flight.

lines 434 and 441: S.busy guard makes a second submit return at once while the button shows 'Checking N rows...'; 565-566 same guard for import, and the view switches to the progress screen so Import cannot be pressed again.

Synchronous changes before any await: 443 check button label, 573 switch to progress view, 602-603 'Stopping...', 404 'Reading file...', 541 table re-render on filter change, 545-547 more rows appended and focused.

lines 607-641: every import ending (done, stopped, failed, unknown) gets a heading and text with imported, skipped and remaining counts; 454 states check failure; 414-421 file load result; 466 a successful check shows the review.

No toasts or banners. The outcome heading 'N contacts imported' (615) reports a server-side result not otherwise visible; file status (414-417) adds file name and line count and warns of replaced text. 429 'earlier text is back' is the one redundant line.

Errors render in place and persist: csv-error 385 until the next check, check-failure block 388-391 until retry, file errors 400-401 and 420-421, result view 626-640. No timers remove any message; the only timeout (280) feeds the screen-reader region.

lines 409-414: a chosen file replaces pasted text at once and shows 'Undo: put back the text that was here' (141, 425-431); Stop import runs without a prompt and the rest can be resumed (638); Back keeps the text.

Import cannot be recalled; it is preceded by the review step: 484-486 name how many rows will be imported and how many skipped, buttons are 'Import N contacts' and 'Back to edit contacts' (490, 160), and focus lands on the heading, not Import (378-379).
No confirmation dialogs in the page. The only prompt is the browser leave prompt, raised solely while an import is running (681-683), which is rare and costly to interrupt.
No optimistic updates: review renders only after validateImport resolves (445-466) and import counts come from onProgress and the resolved or rejected result (577-589).
No modal dialogs: no dialog element, no showModal, no overlay markup or styles; steps are sections toggled with hidden (370).
No modal dialogs in the page (see NAV-008).

lines 118-150: heading, a one-line step list, then the CSV field and Check button; 155-183 review opens with the result heading, the Import/Back actions and the rows table; nothing decorative precedes the task.
lines 117-134: h1 'Import contacts', the step list, then the working field. No hero, greeting or introductory panel.

Only numbers shown are ready, problem and total row counts (477-493), the displayed-rows count (533-535), progress (558) and outcome counts (612-640); each informs the go-ahead, stop or resume decision. No stat cards or charts.

lines 162-167 and 493-496: the filter is a visible radio group 'Rows with problems (N)' / 'All rows (N)' directly above the table, with 'All rows' as the one-step clear; 533-535 shows 'Showing all N rows with problems' or 'first 200 of N'.

All controls are native: textarea 134, file input 139, buttons 141-204, radios 164-165, form submit 469. Focus is moved on each view change (378-379) and to the first new row after Show more (546-547); focus-visible outlines at 75-78. No click-only widgets.

Problem cells get background plus bold (90) and the row's Problem column states it in text (524); errors carry a 'Problem: ' text prefix (62) and a thicker border (50); current step is bold and underlined with aria-current (40, 372).

Live regions exist in the initial markup: #live role=status 126 (used by say at 280, 444, 562, 604), csv-error role=alert 135, file-status role=status 140, check-error role=alert 144, table-count role=status 167. File errors use status rather than alert.
No accordions, disclosure buttons, menus, comboboxes or tabs; 'Show N more rows' (543) appends rows and the filter is a native radio group (162-166).

lines 99-112: under 700px the table becomes stacked label/value blocks via data-label (104-105), action buttons go full width (108), the filter stacks (109-111); textarea and file input are width 100% / max-width 100% (45, 53); targets are 44px (68, 82).
